## Failure Report

`symptom`, `cause`, `remedy`, `codeText` (v1 taxonomy: mechanical / electrical / control / operator / external / wear / unknown — a Failure Code card is v1.1), `detectedAt`, `operatorError`, `assetDown`, `recurrenceOfId`. **Raise Work Order** reads `assetDown` to take the asset out of service and open an unplanned Downtime; **Complete Work Order** requires `remedy` on corrective work.

cardInfo.name: Failure Report
cardInfo.summary: Why a thing failed and what fixed it — symptom, cause, remedy, failure code, asset down, repeat fault.

containedExamples.symptom: Forklift 3 brake pedal soft, stopping distance doubled
containedExamples.cause: Hydraulic line weep at rear union
containedExamples.remedy: Union replaced, system bled and tested
